headline: Alibaba shares fall 6% as AI spending drives 75% drop in net income
detail: This headline underscores the significant capital expenditure required for AI development, which can severely impact even large tech companies' net income. For your tech-heavy portfolio, it's a crucial reminder that AI growth comes with substantial costs.
rec: No direct trade on Alibaba, but this serves as a general caution for the profitability outlook of tech names heavily investing in AI.

headline: Treasury yields rebound, wiping out the decline following Bessent's intervention
detail: Rising Treasury yields typically make future earnings of growth-oriented tech stocks less attractive, as their valuations are more sensitive to higher discount rates. This trend could put further pressure on your concentrated tech and chip holdings.
rec: No specific trade is warranted by this headline alone, but remain vigilant for potential downward pressure on your tech positions.
